title: euphrasia officinalis var. salisburgensis
intro: Euphrasia officinalis var. salisburgensis, commonly known as Salzburg eyebright, is a variant of the Euphrasia officinalis plant, a type of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. This plant is traditionally used to treat eye and ear infections, as well as respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Salzburg eyebright include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in soothing irritated mucous membranes and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
